- No unexpected configuration changes occurred on S-SFX-005 or its parents during the window. [T5]

- T5: No changes were recorded on S-SFX-005 or its parent topology during the incident window, ruling out a bad change.

- Verify post-maintenance health metrics and ensure site stability following battery replacement.
